Production credentials exist only in the deployed function's environment. For development there is a separate sandbox account whose key is in the dev secrets store; export it as MAIL_API_KEY. The sandbox has the same API and response shapes, but it is rate-limited to 2 messages per second and capped at 500 messages a day for the whole team, so do not loop over large fixtures. Bounces and complaints are simulated with magic addresses from the provider's docs. Needs MAIL_API_KEY (the sandbox key from the dev secrets store) and MAIL_SINK_URL (the sink inbox API base URL); skipped otherwise. The sandbox accepts mail to any address with a 202 but only delivers to the @sink.acme.test domain, so the recipient must live there or the delivery check can never pass. The sandbox is capped at 500 messages a day for the whole team: this test sends exactly one. """ import os import time import uuid from unittest import mock import pytest import requests from notifier import email pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif( not (os.environ.get("MAIL_API_KEY") and os.environ.get("MAIL_SINK_URL")), reason="needs MAIL_API_KEY (sandbox) and MAIL_SINK_URL", ) SINK_ADDR = "receipts@sink.acme.test" DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_S = 60 POLL_INTERVAL_S = 2 def _sink_messages(): resp = requests.get( f"{os.environ['MAIL_SINK_URL'].rstrip('/')}/inboxes/{SINK_ADDR}/messages", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['MAIL_API_KEY']}"}, timeout=10, ) resp.raise_for_status() return resp.json()["messages"] def _wait_for_delivery(message_id): deadline = time.monotonic() + DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_S while time.monotonic() < deadline: for msg in _sink_messages(): if msg["id"] == message_id: return msg time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_S) pytest.fail(f"message {message_id} not delivered to {SINK_ADDR} " f"within {DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_S}s") def test_send_receipt_is_delivered(): invoice_id = f"inv_it_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}" # render() has no templates yet; stub it with a body carrying the # invoice id so the delivered message can be matched to this run. body = f"

Receipt for {invoice_id}: 1200
